column1: # Polish grammar words. One line per word as written + part of speech:
# word <TAB> UD part of speech <TAB> senses separated by " | ".
# The file replaces Wiktionary's determiner, pronoun, preposition, conjunction,
# particle and auxiliary entries for every word listed here; nouns, verbs and
# other content words stay (je "eats", mam "I have"). See apps/importer/src/grammar.ts.
# Each sense explains what the word does, for a learner reading it next to
# the sentence: what it expresses, then the English, then a short phrase in
# brackets when the English alone doesn't settle it ("every, for regular repeats: every year (co roku)"). No notes
# on case or position: the sentence shows those.
# A form names its base word, which links it: "past of być: was → być".
